Whoever acts contrary to these provisions or annuls any of them shall be liable.’

I have issued a decision that you must not do anything with the elders of the Jews concerning the building of that house of God. From the king’s resources, from the taxes beyond the river, let the expense be diligently supplied to those men, so that it is not stopped.

I have also issued a decision: for anyone who changes this word, a timber will be taken down from his house, and he will be raised upright and fastened upon it. His house will be dealt with according to me.

The God whose name dwells there will overthrow every king and people who stretches out a hand to alter or destroy that house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decision; it shall be carried out diligently.”
